t: This is the Portland Hospital for Women and Children on Great Portland Street, a private maternity hospital owned by the Hospital Corporation of America. It's known for royal births. Princess Beatrice and Princess Eugenie, daughters of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor and Sarah Ferguson, were both born here. So was Prince Archie, son of Prince Harry and Meghan, and Lady Margarita Armstrong-Jones, granddaughter of Princess Margaret. Formula One driver Alexander Albon was also born here, as was Prince Joseph Wenzel of Liechtenstein.
